answer: To keep farms from minting many keys cheaply, admission is a live courier trial. A newcomer posts a slashable bond and pre-commits a hash of a seed-derived flight plan. One designated falcon then carries a unique sable token—an epoch-seeded, single-use capability—along hops revealed only after each prior receipt lands. Established peers stand on a public terrace, open that token, and post its checksum. Shared plans, hop timings, or identical checksums slash every overlapping bond, so each extra identity still costs a full, unshareable courier run.
